# Kwao Thai Restaurant — Website Concept

> A design concept reusing our restaurant template. This is not the restaurant's official website.

## Sources

The site owner supplied copied homepage text and a screenshot from https://www.kwaothai.com on October 23, 2026. The source website was not independently retrieved in this environment.

## Supplied business information

- Name: Kwao Thai Restaurant.
- Address: 1207 A Esquimalt Road, Victoria, BC V9A 3P2, Canada.
- Phone: +1 250-389-1845.
- Tuesday–Sunday: lunch 11:00–14:30 and dinner 16:30–21:00, local Victoria time.
- Closed Monday. The supplied screenshot also says all statutory holidays are closed.
- Dine-in and takeout are available. Allow 30–35 minutes for preparation; confirm timing by phone.
- Online ordering links are on the restaurant's official website. Delivery is listed through DoorDash and Localpass. Direct checkout links were not supplied.
- Available spice levels: Mild, Mild-Med, Med, Hot, Thai Hot.
- Vegetarian and vegan options are available. Customers should disclose allergies when ordering and confirm preparation.

- [Menu and ordering](https://mapal-27.github.io/Website/kwao-thai/menu.html)
- [Official restaurant website](https://www.kwaothai.com)

## Limitations

The user supplied the website menu text on October 23, 2026. The menu page transcribes all 52 supplied items across 8 categories, with protein and portion options in CAD. The source explicitly warns its PDF is inaccurate; this concept uses the website text instead. Pineapple Fried Rice lists conflicting base prices ($18/$19); Lamb Pad King and Lamb Pad Prig Thai Dum each list $21.50/$22.50. Their conflicting base prices are not presented as confirmed offers; customers are asked to call. Tom Kha and Tom Yum portion descriptions also conflict, so portion sizes are not guessed. No lunch-special dishes were provided despite a Lunch Special heading, so none are invented. Customer review text, ratings, email, and direct ordering-provider URLs remain unavailable. Illustrative Thai cuisine photos are AI-generated and do not depict confirmed Kwao Thai dishes. The menu is rendered as searchable HTML, works without JavaScript, and does not use a PDF. Confirm current prices and availability by phone. This concept is marked noindex pending review; it is not intended to compete with the official site in search results.
